idea: Vehicle generation by shifted negative exponential headway h = hmin + (H - hmin)(-ln(1-R)); to guarantee the specified volume V in each 15 minutes generate N = V/4 headways and scale all by K = (15 x 60)/sum(h_i) (Eq 10.2), which fixes the count (removes one source of randomness) but changes the distribution if K differs from 1; offer as an option.
does: Option for the arrival pattern: either stochastic count (Poisson) or exact count per interval with headways rescaled; lets experiments separate demand randomness from driver randomness.

notes: Shifted exponential with minimum headway also prevents impossible sub-second headways; check ACMS Random pattern.
